passes.note: Third-person (VS-CONTRACT) review found HIGH-1 (HTTP boundary dropped typo'd system_prompt) and HIGH-2 (missing query_id fabricated NDCG). Both fixed + GAP-2 param passthrough. Pass count reset per policy: code changed after a clean pass.

categories.evidence: 16 tests. Real HTTP server, real socket. Live call served ahead of a batch; fairness floor forces job progress under continuous call load (with a disabled-floor control proving the floor does real work); partial job completion retrievable.

5 tests. Real on-disk SQLite across a process boundary; a real SIGKILL of a child mid-lease leaves a durable, reclaimable lease; requeue continues attempt numbering and does not duplicate a job's results.

9 tests. REAL Ollama: a ~12k-token prompt against num_ctx=2048 raised TruncationError not a returned answer (17s); an explicit 32768 window evaluated the whole prompt and the needle survived (76s). Eligibility filters on effective (not advertised) windows.

10 tests. Every terminal call has a complete trace; evaluated tokens recorded; metrics reconcile exactly with raw rows; truncated_calls metric known-zero in health and 1 under truncation; content failure diagnosed as prompt/model, truncation as harness (inverse drill), exhaustion as availability; trace store holds no credential-shaped strings.

7 tests. Observed exhaustion shapes (Gemini 429, OpenRouter free-models-per-day) classify as availability; content failures do NOT fall through; quota exhaustion mid-batch switches between calls and the batch still completes; exhausted stays distinct from failed; provider swap requires no caller change.

11 tests. Vendored retail-search NDCG verified byte-for-byte against upstream (SHA + suffix match); graded gain and idealDCG==0 guard correct; out-of-scale grades rejected not clamped; incomplete judgments return null not a confident 0; @10-over-8 reported as @8 with a warning.

live_end_to_end.routing_call: Real live Command Center-style routing call resolved on REAL Gemini, intent parsed correctly, trace captured.
live_end_to_end.relevance_job: Real relevance job on the local model: rain jacket=3, t-shirt=0, windbreaker=1, backpack=1, nDCG 0.975.
live_end_to_end.live_fallback_observed: Real Gemini 429 quota exhaustion occurred during the live run and fell over to local, captured in trace call_3823eb98 with the genuine Google quota error message — the named 'quota exhaustion' scenario proven against real providers, not simulated.

resolved_during_generation: attempt_no collided with UNIQUE(call_id, attempt_no) on requeue -> would have broken machine-sleep recovery (BDD-005/014). Fixed: continue numbering from prior max.

system_prompt silently dropped (snake_case/camelCase mismatch) -> masqueraded as a bad-prompt/model failure. Fixed: normalizeCallInput throws on unknown fields. This is the BDD-018 trap and was caught by trace evidence.
ndcgForJudgments returned 0 for zero-judgment rankings -> plausible-wrong-number risk (MISSION.md:93). Fixed: refuses to score incomplete judgments.
token estimator under-counted chat scaffolding by ~2x. Fixed: measured overhead (48 tokens/message).
